Go to the "Raw Captures" tab, tap any recording, and choose "Save to Downloads" to create a transferable zip package.
How to Shoot the Perfect 3D Scan

1. Hold Still for 3 Seconds:
 Wait until the top indicator turns GREEN. This locks ARCore to true Earth gravity.

2. Walk the Perimeter Slowly:
 Walk steadily around the room. Avoid quick wrist snaps or running.

3. Overlap to Close the Loop:
 Finish by returning to where you started, overlapping by 1–2 metres.

4. Where Files Go:
 Raw: Android/data/com.posecam/files/captures/
 Exports: Public Downloads/PoseCam/

5. On Your PC:
 Run: python src/run_pipeline.py --posecam path/to/capture --name my_room

How to turn your phone scan into 3D Model 1 & Model 8:

Step 1: Connect Phone to PC with USB cable (set USB mode to "File Transfer / MTP").

Step 2: Copy your exported ZIP or session folder from:
Phone > Internal Storage > Download > PoseCam > capture-XXXX.zip
(or from Android/data/com.posecam/files/captures/)

Step 3: On PC, open terminal and run:
python src/run_pipeline.py --posecam data/capture-XXXX --name room_scan

This automatically builds the metric TSDF mesh, 100% flat ground plane, and Model 1 & 8 views!
